The sweep runs for the entries the change can affect, and starts when the decision failed; the gate tells a sweep skipped by that decision from one that did not run.
The gate carries `always()` so that a skipped sweep does not skip it.
`brew audit` waits for the job that says whether the change can affect it, and runs unless that job answered `false`.
The gate carries `always()` so that a skipped audit does not skip it, and it is the check a ruleset requires.
The scheduled update validates what it rendered; it is no check a merge waits for.
The scheduled update commits what it rendered and validated; it is no check a merge waits for.
